title: Activists shift anti-CEC demonstration to Pune and hold protest
seoTitle: Pune protest against Chief Election Commissioner

tea.why: Activists protested against alleged irregularities in the electoral process and demanded accountability from election authorities.
tea.want: Demonstrators demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, the cancellation of the SIR exercise, and broader electoral reforms.
tea.changed: Oct 11: Pune Police detained around 100 protesters at Goodluck Chowk after permission for the gathering was denied.

summary: Activists shifted their demonstration to Pune following an earlier detention incident involving Madhya Pradesh police while traveling to Delhi. Organised by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and allied student and youth groups, protesters gathered at Goodluck Chowk in Pune to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, the cancellation of the SIR exercise, and electoral reforms. Pune Police intervened because permission for the gathering had been denied and because the demonstration caused a traffic jam extending up to 500 metres. Deputy Commissioner of Police Krushikesh Rawale stated that law enforcement had to take action to prevent disruptions to emergency vehicles. Protesters criticized the police action, alleging excessive force and unusual harshness during the detentions.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Accountability from the country's election authorities
response: Pune Police detained around 100 protesters at Goodluck Chowk after the gathering continued despite permission being denied. Deputy Commissioner of Police Krushikesh Rawale stated that action was necessary because the crowd caused a 500-metre traffic jam that could affect emergency vehicles.

arrests.text: Around 100 protesters... were detained by Pune Police

updates.text: Freed activists announced they would hold their anti-CEC demonstration in Pune rather than Delhi.
Pune Police detained around 100 protesters at Goodluck Chowk after denying permission for the gathering.
